paragraphs: In the heart of Jalisco, our story begins in San José de Gracia, a land that is part of who we are and that we carry with pride in every bottle of Hacienda La Muralla.
This is where a way of understanding Mexican pride is born: one that grows with time, is handed down from generation to generation and endures in everything we do.
Among the agave fields and the beauty of the Jalisco landscape, our passion for tequila was born. Every bottle carries a piece of this land and a story that is still being written.

tequilas.subtitle: Blue agave from Los Altos, two ways to know it.

items.name: Muralla Blanco
items.description: Crystalline and direct: cooked agave just as it comes off the still, with the mineral freshness of the red earth.

items.name: Muralla Reposado
items.description: Rested in oak barrels until it finds its moment: ripe agave, vanilla and a warm, woody finish.

short.description: Crystalline and direct: cooked agave just as it comes off the still.
Rested in oak until it finds its moment: ripe agave and vanilla.

steps.title: Cultivation
steps.text: 6 to 8 years in the red earth of Los Altos. The altitude and cold nights concentrate the agave's sugar.

steps.title: Harvest
steps.text: With the coa, the jimador cuts away the leaves until the piña is clean, ready for the oven.

steps.title: Cooking and milling
steps.text: Heat turns the agave into sugars; milling separates the juice, the mosto, from the fiber.

steps.title: Distillation and rest
steps.text: Double distillation, hearts only. The Reposado rests in oak before bottling.

terroir.text: The agaves of Los Altos ripen slowly. That is why our tequila is sweet, fruity and mineral.
